identity.mount: Both supplied routes lazy-mount the same page through SafeRoute; source-confirmed, not browser-confirmed.

purpose: Inspect a selected vehicle's reported firmware versions, update lifecycle history, monthly cadence and optional Helix narration.
primaryGoal: Understand reported software update events and follow public version-specific release notes without mistaking loaded history for independently verified installed firmware.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with non-null selected vehicle; abort signal forwarded; inherits query policy. Typed array includes id, vehicle_id, version, status and nullable schedule/install dates. Server normalizes nil results to []. SQL sorts by created_at descending and filters created_at. Offset is sent but ignored by this handler/repository.
dataSources.ownership: Page orchestrates; hook fetches; server owns durable history. No full-range aggregation endpoint established.

dataSources.behavior: Shared workspace selection resolves vehicle ID and an always-array vehicle list; page maps display_name with VIN fallback. This page does not render another vehicle selector.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing AI feature scaffold and feature registry
dataSources.behavior: Explicit opt-in request with positive integer vehicle_id; feature HOC hides it when off. Vehicle scope is stream identity. Page range and pagination are not sent to narration. Actual backend AI response behavior and route guard were not exercised.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing workspace preference and formatter infrastructure
dataSources.behavior: Both routes registered for header-owned date scope; hook ignores this page's legacy all-time default on header-owned routes. Number formatting subscribes to saved preferences. Dates/month buckets currently use browser timezone/locale.

CardGrid.tsx:25-40 measures allocated container width and delegates row packing; SoftwareHistoryItem.tsx:8-12 preserves placement.
Version cards use min-w-0, wrapping badges, break-words vehicle caption and a fixed 44px external-link target at page:295-312.

Timeline has list/listitem roles; CardGrid adds intervening group/grid wrappers. Actual accessibility-tree list semantics require browser/screen-reader verification.

states.initialLoading: softwareSourceState suppresses initial metrics and cadence; status/timeline skeletons remain inside persistent cards.
states.empty: Successful [] is an observed zero count; version/install/cadence remain missing. Cadence, status and timeline show localized empty feedback.
states.unavailable: No selected vehicle disables history query and offers manage-vehicles navigation; non-array payload is coerced for derivations and marked unavailable by presenter.
states.fatalError: No retained array: retry feedback replaces source body, not every page section.
states.refreshError: Retained array preserved; summary and cadence show failure context, status/timeline use historical SourceContent retained banner and retry.
states.offline: historySource detects paused refresh for status and timeline, but presenter omits pause/freshness for summary and cadence.
states.ai: Off-mode absence is intentional existing feature policy, not an unauthorized hidden deterministic section. Positive vehicle required; explicit action streams narration.

issues.detail: Summary/cadence use softwareSourceState(data,isLoading,isError), which cannot represent retained paused/offline refresh. historySource handles this for status/timeline via VehicleSourceContent.tsx:17. Trust presentation differs for the same source.
issues.fix: Derive retained/blocked context from the existing DataState for every source-backed section while preserving arrays, unavailable handling and independent recovery. Do not fabricate offline measurements or replace retained content.

visualIssues.detail: Timeline icon chips use neonColorMap backgrounds/rings and fixed 300-level text from tokens.ts:21-26. This is not a new hex palette or a glow call, but retains saturated feature decoration and fixed light text whose composed light-theme contrast is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing restrained semantic status variables for chip icon/background/border, retaining icon and localized Badge meaning; never reset saved chart/theme choices.

visualIssues.detail: Known status bars pass fixed hex colors from softwareUpdateStatus.ts:36-78 and use MetricBar's default gradient. Existing MetricBar supports solid fills and CSS variables, so a new progress primitive is unnecessary.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt existing semantic variables with fill='solid', retaining counts, denominator, order and text labels. Evaluate actual rendered contrast centrally.

architectureIssues.detail: Frontend sends offset and exposes Pagination, but handler.go:43 discards apiparams.Pagination's offset. Repository signatures and SQL software_update_repo.go:23-35,53-65 accept only limit, no OFFSET. Subsequent pages request the same leading rows; a full page keeps yielding synthetic next-page availability.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must thread validated offset through repository/handler with deterministic pagination and tests, preserving array contract and filters; do not merely remove the page action.

architectureIssues.detail: Page sends calendar start/end instead of startInstant/endInstantExclusive. useRangeState.ts:656-682 exposes precise rolling and timezone bounds, while apiparams/params.go:65-82 documents date-only UTC parsing. Rolling 24h and local-day semantics are therefore not forwarded.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass shared hook RFC3339 instant bounds through the typed query; include precise bounds in query identity/reset behavior, retaining cancellation and current request policy. Server already documents support for instant bounds; validate boundary behavior in integration.

architectureIssues.detail: Empty recovery advertises 'View all time' but calls resetRange. On these header-owned routes useRangeState.ts:301-317 overrides defaultPresetId='all' with product default; reset at :484 resolves that effective default. The advertised action need not select all time.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing shared setPreset('all') when available and atomically reset pagination, or relabel reset to its actual workspace default. Preserve header ownership and avoid a second picker.

architectureIssues.detail: Unknown wire statuses resolve to known 'available' metadata, so timeline displays a false lifecycle claim. SoftwareUpdateStatusBreakdown.tsx:39 filters to known keys only, omitting unknown rows from visible distribution while keeping them in denominator.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve raw unknown status with localized unknown/future-status presentation and explicit uncategorized count; reuse Badge neutral variant and keep all-row denominator. Do not silently recategorize or drop future statuses.

architectureIssues.detail: monthLabel uses browser locale directly; formatDate calls omit supported locale/timezone options, while numeric formatting subscribes to saved locale. Calendar bucket timezone is also browser-local, not an explicitly selected display timezone.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing date/locale/timezone presentation mechanisms consistently at the boundary, preserving raw ISO timestamps and monthly operands; do not create another formatter.

dataBehavior: Query key and enablement/cancellation remain intact.
Counts describe loaded rows, not fleet/full-range aggregate. Existing help explicitly explains this scope.
Latest version is first returned row, not independently verified installed firmware; preserve its explicit limitation.
Installed count uses exact installed status; pending is every non-installed row.
Cadence raw numeric measurement is seconds; only display formatter divides by 86400. No physical SI wire/cache fields are changed.
Monthly counts use installed_at with created_at fallback, whereas server range filtering uses created_at. Preserve and explain these distinct meanings.
Last installed selects latest nonempty installed date; cadence uses only finite installed timestamps.
Unknown data must remain missing, not fabricated zero; successful [] yields observed count zero.
Keep every version/date/vehicle identity/status/release-note action and specialist explanation.
AI remains opt-in and independent of deterministic history; no request was invoked.
